attempts.root_cause: The queue launcher propagated an empty LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Isaac could not load libGL.so.1, libX11.so.6, or libXt.so.6, Vulkan returned ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_DRIVER, and no GPU device or renderer was created.
attempts.intervention: After retained logs established the zero-request renderer failure, only worker process group 546021 was terminated. The guard recorded worker exit -15, the queue exited, and its atomic single-client lock was released.
attempts.repair: Require and explicitly pass the known ali-owned RoboLab, GLVND, and system native-library path before retrying seed 8501 under attempt02.
